entities.summary: Waheed Abdul-Ridha Waheed Karaawi is an Iraqi boxer. He competed at the 2016 Summer Olympics in the men's middleweight event, in which he was eliminated in the round of 32 by Misael Rodríguez. He was the flag bearer for Iraq at the Parade of Nations.
